decisions.reason: A semi-hard cheese wheel sits squarely within the firm's established organic dairy and cheese-making knowledge, and its 2019 promotion to a dedicated page suggests the firm has interpreted early results positively and can keep refining it.

The spicy cheese line builds on the firm's core cheese competence and survived the 2019 portfolio pruning with its own page, though the flavored line with several variants carries some risk given that the flavored flagship B was dropped.

The mild creamy soft cheese closely uses the firm's existing soft-cheese know-how and was kept and highlighted in 2019 while the more demanding washed-rind cheese F was dropped, indicating the firm judged it a viable fit with its capabilities.
